evaluation_protocol: Part A: Full-Dataset In-Sample Coordinate Purity
evaluation_nature: Descriptive In-Sample Feature Projection Purity (NOT Generalization)
scientific_interpretation: Empirical coordinate-majority vote purity under 4D feature compression. 5.39% represents multi-flow projection collisions in 4D space, NOT the Bayes error of the underlying network flows.

evaluation_protocol: Part B1: Train-Derived Lookup on P1-1 Frozen Test Set
evaluation_nature: Lookup Table Generalization with Coordinate Repetition (98.81% Overlap)
scientific_interpretation: 98.81% of test rows map to training coordinates. Simple majority lookup achieves 94.47% on covered rows and 94.24% overall, proving that high test accuracy is driven by memorization of shared coordinates rather than generalizable learning.

evaluation_protocol: Part B2: Train-Derived Lookup on Coordinate-Disjoint Test Set
evaluation_nature: Lookup Table Under Strictly Coordinate-Disjoint Partitioning (0.00% Overlap)
scientific_interpretation: Under coordinate-disjoint partitioning, coordinate lookup coverage is exactly 0.0%. Lookup prediction completely fails and collapses to the empirical target class prevalence (72.58%).

evaluation_protocol: Part C1: Novel Coordinates in P1-1 Test Partition (N=31,143)
evaluation_nature: Evaluation Strictly on Unseen Coordinate Manifold
scientific_interpretation: Lookup defaults to global class prior (attack rate on novel subset = 74.83%). Supervised XGBoost achieves 74.79% (MCC=0.0416), while Clean Class-Aware CORAL achieves 39.59% (MCC=0.3904 on this subset).

evaluation_protocol: Part C2: Unseen Coordinates in Disjoint Test Partition (N=1,970,428)
scientific_interpretation: Lookup defaults to target prior (72.58%). In-domain disjoint XGBoost achieves 68.95% (MCC=0.2539), LightGBM achieves 71.05% (MCC=0.3298), while Clean Class-Aware CORAL achieves 35.94% (MCC=0.0795).
